title: STOP LOOKING BACK, GOD HAS MORE AHEAD
text: I want you to bow your heads wherever you are. Father, we thank you for the [music] gift of life. We thank you for your mercies that are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness, oh God. We bless your name for the privilege to gather in your presence once again. Lord, we ask that as we open our hearts to receive from you. Let your spirit [music] have its way. Let every word that proceeds from this altar carry the anointing that breaks the yoke. We pray that limitations will [music] be destroyed, that every backward thing will be cancelled, and that men and [music] women will step into their prophetic destinies in the name of Jesus. Sanctify our hearts, purify our motives, and let us encounter you in a dimension that will change our [music] story forever. We pray in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen. You may be seated in the presence of [music] the Lord. I want to talk to you this morning about something that has become [music] a spiritual prison to many believers. There are people who are physically present in 2025, but their spirits, [music] their minds, their focus are still locked in 2015, 20120 [music] or even further back. They are carrying weights from seasons that God has already concluded. They are mourning over opportunities that [music] have passed, grieving over relationships that have ended, and rehearsing failures that God has already forgiven and forgotten. And while [music] they are doing this, the enemy is successfully robbing them of the now and the next that heaven has prepared. The title of our discourse [music] this morning is very simple but extremely powerful. Stop looking back. God [music] has more ahead. I need you to hear me clearly. God has more ahead. Not just something ahead, more ahead, more glory, more grace, more power, more territory, more souls, more manifestation, more revelation. And the tragedy is that while heaven is [music] saying come up higher, many are saying let me go back lower. While God is preparing to open doors, no man can shut. Some of you are still standing at the doors that have been shut for 5 years, begging them to open. While God is ready to connect you with new [music] relationships that will take you into purpose, you are still crying over people who walked away from you 3 years ago. I want you to open your Bibles with me to the book of Genesis chapter 19. I'm reading from verse 17. The Bible says, "And [music] it came to pass when they had brought them forth abroad that he said, escape for thy life. Look not behind thee, neither stay [music] thou in all the plain, escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed." And then in verse 26, the Bible records, [music] "But his wife looked back from behind him and she became a pillar of salt." This is the account of Lot's wife. When God was delivering Lot and his [music] family from Sodom and Gomorrah, he gave them a specific instruction. Do not look back. It was not a suggestion. It was not advised. It was a divine command loaded with prophetic implications. And Lord's [music] wife in what seemed like a harmless glance turned her head to look at what God had already judged. And she became a monument of disobedience, a pillar of salt. Now I need you to understand [music] something. That look was not just physical. It was spiritual. It represented a heart that was still attached to that which God had condemned. While her body was moving forward, her heart was [music] still in sodom. And beloved, there are many Christians today who are in that same condition. Their bodies are in church. Their mouths are speaking the language of faith, but their hearts are still [music] in Egypt, still in Babylon, still in yesterday. And God is saying to you this morning, [music] stop looking back. I have more ahead. Let me show you something else. Turn with me to the book of Philippians chapter 3. [music] I'm reading from verse 13. The Apostle Paul, a man who had encountered Jesus [music] in a dimension that changed the trajectory of his entire existence, said something very profound. He said, "Brethren, I count [music] not myself to have apprehended, but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind and reaching [music] forth onto those things which are before, I press toward the mark for the price of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus." Notice [music] what Paul said, forgetting those things which are behind. Now this is critical. [music] Paul was a man who had a lot to look back on. He had a prestigious background. He was educated at the feet of Gamalia. He was a Pharisee of Pharisees, [music] a Hebrew of Hebrews. He had status. He had influence. He had accomplishments [music] in the religious system of his day. But he also had things he was ashamed of. He had persecuted the church. He had consented to the death of Steven. He had ravaged families, dragged people to prison, and been an [music] instrument of terror to the early believers. So Paul had both achievements [music] and failures in his past. He had things he could boast about and things he could weep over. But he made a conscious, deliberate, spiritual decision. I am forgetting what is behind me. The word forgetting there is very instructive. It doesn't mean that Paul developed spiritual amnesia and couldn't remember his past. It means he made [music] a quality decision to stop allowing his past to define his present and dictate his future. He refused to be paralyzed by what had happened. He refused to be imprisoned by mistakes he had made or opportunities he had missed. [music] And he said, "I'm reaching forth." That word riching in the Greek carries the idea of [music] straining forward, stretching out with intensity like a runner in a race who is leaning forward [music] with everything in him to reach the finish line. Somebody needs to hear this. The reason you're not [music] moving forward is because you're still holding on to what's behind. You're trying to run a race with your head turned backward and you cannot maximize your forward motion when your focus is on what's behind you. It is spiritually, [music] emotionally, and mentally impossible. God is [music] saying to someone here, it is time to let go. It is time to release that hurt. It is time to [music] release that disappointment. It is time to release that person who walked away. [music] It is time to release that business that failed. It is time to release that mistake you made 5 years ago. It is time to release it and press forward into what I have prepared for you. Now let me give you some reasons why [music] people look back. The first reason is familiarity. Human beings are creatures of habit. We are drawn to what we know even when what we know [music] is destructive. This is why the children of Israel after God delivered them from 430 years of [music] slavery started murmmoring in the wilderness saying would to God we had died in Egypt. At least there we had fish and cucumbers and leaks. They wanted to go back to slavery because slavery [music] was familiar. They were so comfortable with their chains that freedom felt threatening. And there are believers today who are in the same bondage. God is trying to take them into a new dimension, but they keep reaching back to old patterns, old relationships, old mindsets because those things are [music] familiar even though they are limiting. The second reason people look back is unresolved pain. When you have been hurt and you have not allowed the healing [music] power of the Holy Spirit to minister to that wound, that pain becomes like an anchor that keeps [music] pulling you back. You keep rehearsing what was said to you, what was done to you, how you were betrayed, how you were abandoned. And every time you rehearse it, you [music] are giving that situation power over your present. Listen to me. Unforgiveness is one of the greatest backward pulls in the kingdom. When you refuse to forgive, you are [music] literally chaining yourself to the person who hurt you. You are saying, "I'm going [music] to hold on to this offense and in doing so, I'm going to remain connected to that painful season." And God is saying, "Release them." Not because they deserve it, but because you deserve to be free. The third reason is fear of the unknown. The future [music] is uncertain. It requires faith. And many believers would rather stay in a familiar yesterday than step into an uncertain tomorrow. But let me tell you something. Faith always requires forward motion. Abraham had to leave of the Chaldes not knowing where he was going. Moses had [music] to lead the children of Israel into a wilderness with no GPS, no map, just a cloud by day and fire by night. The three Hebrew boys had to walk into the fire [music] not knowing if they will come out. Faith is spelled R I S K. And if you are waiting for all the details before you move forward, you will never move because God reveals [music] his plans progressively, not exhaustively. Let me give you another scripture. [music] Isaiah chapter 43. I'm reading from verse 18. The Lord says, "Remember [music] ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. Now it shall [music] spring forth. Shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. This is a powerful declaration. God is saying stop remembering [music] the former things. Now again, God is not saying don't learn from your past. He's saying don't live in it. Don't camp there. Don't set up your tent in yesterday because while you are obsessing over the former things, I'm doing a new thing. And if your eyes are fixed on what [music] was, you will miss what is and what is coming. God says, "Behold, I will do a new thing." The word behold means pay attention, take note, focus is a call to shift your gaze. And then he says it will spring forth. That means it's going to happen suddenly, rapidly, unexpectedly. But here's the question God asked. Shall you not know it? In other words, will you recognize it? Will you perceive it? Or will you be so busy looking at the old that you miss the new? There are people who are in the season of their new thing, but they don't know it because they are still mourning over the old thing. The new job [music] is available, but you are still crying over the job you lost. The new relationship is in front of you, [music] but you are still stalking your ex on social media. The new door is open, but you are still knocking on the door that got shut. Somebody say, "I will not miss my season." Say it again. I will not miss my season because I was looking back. Now I want to give you some practical keys on [music] how to stop looking back. The first one is this. You must cultivate a spirit of gratitude for where you are now. One of the strategies of the enemy is to make you [music] despise your present by glorifying your past. He will show you all the good things that [music] were in that season and hide all the pain, all the struggle, all the bondage. is like a person who gets out of a toxic relationship and then starts remembering only the good times and forgetting why they left in the first place. You must discipline your mind to see the [music] grace of God in your present moment. Even if where you are is not where you want to be, you must thank God that you are [music] not where you used to be. The Bible says in 1 Thessalonians 5:18, "In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in [music] Christ Jesus concerning you." Notice it says in everything, not for everything. You don't have to thank God for the betrayal, [music] but you can thank him in the betrayal that he's still with you. You don't have to thank God for the loss, but you can [music] thank him in the loss that he's still your provider. Gratitude shifts your focus from what you [music] have lost to what you still have. And when you begin to operate in thanksgiving, you will discover that [music] what you have is enough to get you to where you're going. The second key is this. You must renew your mind with the word of God. Romans 12:2 says, "Be not conformed to this world, but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind that ye may prove [music] what is that good and acceptable and perfect will of God." Transformation happens in the mind before it manifests in your life. If your mind is filled with memories [music] of failure, your present will look like your past. If your mind is filled [music] with thoughts of inadequacy, you will keep sabotaging your own progress. But when you saturate your mind with what God says about you, when you meditate on his [music] promises, when you declare his word over your life, something begins to shift in [music] the realm of the spirit. You need to start confessing scriptures over your life every morning. Say, I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. I am blessed coming in [music] and blessed going out. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. I can do [music] all things through Christ who strengthens me. He who began a good work in me will complete it. I am more than a conqueror. I am fearfully and wonderfully made. When you begin to speak these truths, they start to override the lies that have been holding you back. The third key is this. Surround [music] yourself with forwardthinking people. Proverbs 13:20 says, "He that walketh [music] with wise men shall be wise, but a companion of fools shall be destroyed. Show me your friends and I will show you your future." If you are surrounded by people who are constantly complaining, constantly living in regret, constantly [music] talking about what could have been, you will remain stuck. But if you position yourself around people who are pressing forward, people who are prophetic, [music] people who are talking about what God is about to do, you will find yourself moving forward without even realizing it. Association determines assimilation. The conversations you engage in shape the direction of your life. The fourth key is this. Set new goals and pursue them with violence. One of the reasons people look back is because [music] they have nothing compelling them forward. If you don't have a vision for your future, your past becomes your focus by default. Habacook [music] 2:2 says, "Write the vision and make it plain upon tables that he may run that readth it." God is saying, "Document what [music] I've shown you. Write down where you're going. Make it clear and then run toward it. You need something ahead of you that is so exciting, so God breathed, so [music] purposeful that it pulls you out of yesterday and thrust you into tomorrow. Maybe you need to go back to school. Maybe you need to start that business. Maybe you need to write that book. Maybe you need to launch that ministry. Maybe you need to relocate. Maybe you need to start building new relationships. [music] Whatever it is, set the goal and go after it with holy aggression. Stop waiting for the perfect time. Stop waiting for permission. Stop waiting for everything to line up. [music] Just start. Because motion creates momentum and momentum creates breakthrough. I want to prophesy to someone, the season of looking back is over. The Lord says you have mourned long enough. You have regretted long enough. You have rehearsed that [music] pain long enough. And now the spirit of the Lord is saying arise and shine for your light has come and the glory of the Lord is risen upon you. God is about to do something in your life that is so significant, so undeniable that your past [music] will look like a distant memory. The relationships you lost will pale in comparison to the connections God is about to give you. The opportunities you miss will seem insignificant when you see what God is about to open for you. The failures that have haunted you will become testimonies that [music] will inspire a generation. I see doors opening. I see favor being released. I see divine connections being orchestrated. I see businesses being established. I see ministries being launched. I see barrenness being broken. [music] I see wombs opening. I see financial turnarounds. I see healing and restoration. I see families being reconciled. I see prodigals coming home. I see the wealth of the [music] wicked being transferred to the righteous. I see acceleration. I see multiplication. [music] I see suddenly. And the Lord says if you will release what is behind you, I will [music] release what is before you. But you have to make a choice. You have to decide that you are done being a prisoner of your past. You have to decide that you are done allowing what happened to define what will happen. You have to decide that the pain stops here. The [music] regret stops here. The backward motion stops here. And you have to declare with your mouth and believe in your heart, God has [music] more ahead. Let me tell you about Peter. This is a man who denied Jesus three times. He stood by the fire and said, "I don't know him." He cursed and swore and said, "I am not one of his disciples." And after Jesus was crucified, Peter went back to fishing. He went back to what he knew before he met Jesus. He looked back. He allowed his failure [music] to pull him into his past. But Jesus in his resurrection came to Peter and said, "Do you love me?" Three times he asked. Corresponding [music] to the three times, Peter denied him. And after Peter affirmed his love, Jesus [music] said, "Feed my sheep." In other words, Jesus was saying, "Your failure is not final. Your denial does not disqualify you. I still have a purpose for you. Now, stop looking back at what you did wrong and start looking forward to what I'm calling you to do. And Peter, the same man who denied Jesus, became the one who preached on the day of Pentecost and saw [music] 3,000 souls saved. The same man who ran away in fear, became the one who stood before the Sanhedrin and said, "We ought to obey God rather than men." The same man who looked back eventually learned to press forward. And that's what God is doing with you. He's not holding your past against you. He's inviting you into your future. I want to pray with you right now. I want you to stand on your [music] feet wherever you are. If you're driving, just lift one hand. If you're at home, stand up. If you're in your office, stand up. This is a moment of consecration and release. I'm going to lead you in a prayer. And I want you to pray it with everything in you. Father, I thank you for your word. I thank you [music] that your word is a lamp onto my feet and a light onto my path. Lord, I repent for every time I have looked back when you told me to move forward. I repent for allowing my past to dictate my future. I repent [music] for rehearsing pain, for holding on to offenses, for living in regret. Lord, I release it all right now. I release every person who hurts me. [music] I release every opportunity I missed. I release every failure, every mistake, [music] every disappointment. I declare that I am no longer a slave to my yesterday. I am a son. I am a daughter [music] of the most high God and I am stepping into my prophetic future. Lord, I ask you to [music] heal every wound that has kept me bound. Heal the rejection, heal the betrayal, [music] heal the abuse, heal the abandonment. Pour your oil on every broken place and make me whole. I declare that by the stripes [music] of Jesus, I am healed emotionally, mentally, and spiritually. I am free from the [music] spirit of regret. I am free from the spirit of fear. I am free from the [music] spirit of bitterness. I bind every demonic assignment that has been using my past as a weapon against [music] my future. I command every backward pull to be broken in the name of Jesus. Lord, I thank you that you have more ahead, more grace, more glory, more power, [music] more anointing, more territory, more souls, more joy, more peace, more provision. I declare that my latter days [music] will be greater than my former days. I declare that I'm coming out of the wilderness and entering [music] into my promised land. I declare that divine connections are being [music] established. I declare that what the enemy is told is being restored sevenfold. And I decree and declare over my life. I will not look back. I will not turn back. I will not go back. I am moving forward by the power of the [music] Holy Spirit. My eyes are fixed on Jesus, the author and finisher of my faith. I press toward the mark for the price of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus. This is my season of forward motion and nothing shall stop me. In the mighty name of Jesus, I [music] have prayed. Amen. Now lift your hands one more time. I release the fire of God upon [music] your life right now. Let that fire consume every residue of your past. Let that fire purify your motives. Let that fire ignite your passion for the things of God. I declare acceleration over your life. I declare that you [music] will recover all. I declare that you will run and not be weary. You will walk and not faint. I decree uncommon favor. I decree supernatural provision. I decree divine health. I decree peace [music] in your home. I decree joy unspeakable and full of glory. I decree that your children will serve the Lord. I decree that your [music] business will prosper. I decree that your ministry will flourish. I decree that your [music] name will be known for righteousness. I decree that you are a history maker, a world shaker, a chain breaker, a destiny [music] walker. Receive it by faith in the name of Jesus. Now go [music] forward. Don't look back. God has more ahead. Amen.
